newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends firm.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends firm.

text.p: London white sugar futures maintained early gains on Thursday as sellers backed away and prices ended firmer.
The second-month March contract last traded $1.50 higher at $305.50 a tonne after a session high of $306.00.
But the market remained under pressure due to lack of substantial physical offtake, traders said.
"The market is caught in a range. It was tired of going down but it's unlikely to go up much further," said one.
Analysts pegged resistance on March at around $309.00 in the next few sessions.
